searches.reason: Test whether random-prefix truncation improves useful context dependence or merely changes supervision. Seek paired suffix-length response curves using identical training targets, negative candidates and supervised-position counts, with separate measurements of positional shifts and NextItNet receptive-field limits. This provides a practical alternative to replacement probes whose completed support is currently sparse; training-prefix effects remain in-sample diagnostics.
searches.query: NextItNet sequential recommendation context truncation diagnostics effective receptive field suffix length sensitivity matched supervision position embeddings

searches.reason: Translate qualitative complaints into auditable recommendation judgments: choose now, relevant but defer, redundant, explicitly incompatible, and insufficient information. Seek evidence-linked annotation protocols using only public histories, titles and descriptions, with abstention and inter-rater agreement. Ownership, compatibility, current intent and simulator traits must remain unknown unless directly supported; semantic similarity alone cannot establish them.
searches.query: recommender evaluation actionable relevance current intent redundancy compatibility evidence grounded annotation abstention inter rater agreement item descriptions

searches.reason: Establish whether probes detect known implementation failures and identify affected components before using them to guide training. Seek diagnostic calibration through temporary, reversible interventions on the single frozen NextItNet, including disabled dilated-convolution paths, incorrect padding readouts and removed positional signals. Measure detection sensitivity, false alarms and attribution stability without fitting or combining additional predictors; retain pinned macro validation HR@10 for model selection.
searches.query: neural network diagnostic probes validation fault injection mutation testing activation patching causal dilated convolution sequential recommendation sanity checks
